title: German Chicken Schnitzel
description: A classic German dish made with crispy fried chicken and a side of tangy lemon wedges. This recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: 1. Prepare the breading station by placing the flour, savory seasoning, eggs, and flaky pastry in separate shallow dishes.
2. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
3. Coat each chicken breast in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
4. Dip the floured chicken in the eggs, making sure to coat completely.
5. Roll the egg-coated chicken in the flaky pastry to coat.
6. Heat the margarine in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
7. Fry the coated chicken in the skillet for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
8. Remove the chicken from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
9. Serve the German Chicken Schnitzel hot with a side of lemon wedges.
10. Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
